translations.web: Let them praise Yahweh’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.
translations.bsb: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for He gave the command and they were created.
translations.kjv: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.
translations.asv: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For he commanded, and they were created.
